description: Exits of a TRA, THSR or metro station with where they come out and whether they have stairs, an escalator or a lift, plus where its lifts, toilets and information desks are. Give the coordinates of where you are going to sort the exits by distance. Example: system "TRTC", station "台北101/世貿", lat 25.0336, lon 121.5648.

limit.description: Maximum number of exits to return (default 50).

station.description: Station name in Chinese or English (台北, 板橋, Ximen) or station ID.

system.description: Rail system: TRA (臺鐵), THSR (高鐵) or a metro: TRTC 臺北捷運 Taipei Metro, NTMC 新北捷運 (環狀線) New Taipei Metro, TYMC 桃園機場捷運 Taoyuan Airport MRT, TMRT 臺中捷運 Taichung MRT, KRTC 高雄捷運 Kaohsiung MRT, KLRT 高雄輕軌 Kaohsiung LRT.

name: rail_station_info
title: Station exits and facilities
